Han.name: Liu Bang
Han.title: Emperor Gaozu of Han
Han.note: King of Han from 206 BCE; proclaimed emperor in 202 BCE after defeating Xiang Yu.
Han.note_zh: 前206年受封汉王，前202年击败项羽后称帝。

Han.name: Liu Ying
Han.title: Emperor Hui of Han
Han.note: His mother Empress Lü held real power.
Han.note_zh: 实权掌握在母亲吕后手中。

Han.name: Liu Gong
Han.title: Emperor Shao (Former)
Han.note: A child; Empress Dowager Lü Zhi ruled.
Han.note_zh: 年幼，由吕太后（吕雉）临朝称制。

Han.name: Liu Hong
Han.title: Emperor Shao (Later)
Han.note: A child; Empress Dowager Lü Zhi ruled until her death in 180 BCE.
Han.note_zh: 年幼，吕太后临朝称制直至前180年去世。

Han.name: Liu He
Han.title: Marquis of Haihun
Han.note: Deposed by Huo Guang after 27 days.

Han.name: Liu Kan
Han.title: Emperor Ping of Han
Han.note: A child; Wang Mang held power.

Han.name: Liu Ying
Han.title: Ruzi Ying
Han.note: Never formally enthroned; Wang Mang ruled as acting emperor and founded Xin in 9 CE.
Han.note_zh: 未正式即位，王莽以“假皇帝”身份执政，9年建立新朝。

Xiongnu.name: Jihoushan
Xiongnu.title: Huhanye Chanyu
Xiongnu.note: Rival chanyus split the Xiongnu; Huhanye submitted to Han (53 BCE) and married Wang Zhaojun (33 BCE). His brother Zhizhi ruled the northern part until killed in 36 BCE.
Xiongnu.note_zh: 匈奴分裂、诸单于并立；呼韩邪于前53年归附汉朝，前33年娶王昭君。其兄郅支单于割据北方，前36年被汉军所杀。

Nan-Yue.name: Zhao Tuo
Nan-Yue.title: Emperor Wu of Nanyue
Nan-Yue.note: A Qin general who made himself king of the south; accepted Han overlordship in 196 BCE.
Nan-Yue.note_zh: 原为秦将，自立为南越王，前196年接受汉朝册封。

Nan-Yue.name: Zhao Mo
Nan-Yue.title: Emperor Wen of Nanyue
Nan-Yue.note: Grandson of Zhao Tuo; his tomb was found in Guangzhou in 1983.
Nan-Yue.note_zh: 赵佗之孙，其墓1983年在广州发现。

Nan-Yue.name: Zhao Xing
Nan-Yue.title: King Ai of Nanyue
Nan-Yue.note: Killed by the chancellor Lü Jia for planning to submit to Han.
Nan-Yue.note_zh: 欲内附汉朝，被丞相吕嘉所杀。

Nan-Yue.name: Zhao Jiande
Nan-Yue.title: Zhao Jiande
Nan-Yue.note: Last king; captured when Han conquered Nanyue.
Nan-Yue.note_zh: 南越末代国王，汉灭南越时被俘。

Min-Yue.name: Zou Wuzhu
Min-Yue.title: Wuzhu, King of Minyue
Min-Yue.note: Made King of Minyue by Liu Bang in 202 BCE; when his reign ended is not known.
Min-Yue.note_zh: 前202年被刘邦封为闽越王，卒年不详。

Min-Yue.name: Zou Ying
Min-Yue.title: Ying, King of Minyue
Min-Yue.note: Killed by his brother Yushan in 135 BCE after attacking Nanyue.
Min-Yue.note_zh: 前135年因进攻南越，被弟弟余善所杀。

Min-Yue.name: Zou Yushan
Min-Yue.title: Yushan, King of Dongyue
Min-Yue.note: Rebelled against Han in 111 BCE and was killed by his own nobles in 110 BCE.
Min-Yue.note_zh: 前111年反汉，前110年被部下所杀。

Koguryo.name: Jumong
Koguryo.title: King Dongmyeong
Koguryo.note_zh: 传说中的开国君主，年代为传统说法。

Silla.name: Bak Hyeokgeose
Silla.title: Hyeokgeose Geoseogan
Silla.note_zh: 传说中的开国君主，年代为传统说法。

Protectorate of the Western Regions.name: Zheng Ji
Protectorate of the Western Regions.title: First Protector-General of the Western Regions
Protectorate of the Western Regions.note: Later protectors-general served short terms and are not well recorded.
Protectorate of the Western Regions.note_zh: 此后各任都护任期较短，记载不全。

sides.name: Han and allies
sides.troops_text: Han Xin alone led c. 300,000 (Records of the Grand Historian)

gaixia.note: Surrounded and hearing Chu songs all around (四面楚歌), Xiang Yu broke out with a few hundred riders and died at the Wu River.
gaixia.note_zh: 项羽被围，夜闻四面楚歌，率数百骑突围，最终自刎于乌江。

sides.name: Xiongnu
sides.troops_text: c. 400,000 horsemen (Records of the Grand Historian)

sides.name: Han
sides.troops_text: c. 320,000, mostly infantry (Records of the Grand Historian)

baideng.note: Liu Bang was trapped for seven days and escaped after Chen Ping sent gifts to the chanyu's wife. The figures are probably inflated.
baideng.note_zh: 刘邦被围七天，陈平重贿阏氏后才得以脱身。数字可能有夸大。

sides.name: Seven kings
sides.troops_text: Wu alone c. 200,000 (Records of the Grand Historian)

seven-states.note: Liang held Suiyang while Zhou Yafu cut the rebels' supply lines.
seven-states.note_zh: 梁王坚守睢阳，周亚夫断绝叛军粮道。
seven-states.losses: All seven kings killed or killed themselves

mayi.note: The chanyu learned of the trap from a captured officer and turned back; there was no battle.
mayi.note_zh: 单于从俘虏的汉军尉史口中得知埋伏，引兵退走，未发生交战。

sides.name: Han
sides.troops_text: 10,000 cavalry in the spring raid; more in summer
sides.troops_text_zh: 春季出击骑兵1万，夏季兵力更多

hexi-campaign.note: Afterwards King Hunye killed King Xiutu and surrendered to Han with about 40,000 people.
hexi-campaign.note_zh: 战后浑邪王杀休屠王，率约4万人降汉。
hexi-campaign.losses: Tens of thousands of Xiongnu killed or captured
hexi-campaign.losses_zh: 匈奴数万人被杀或被俘

sides.name: Han
sides.troops_text: 100,000 cavalry, with many more infantry in support
sides.troops_text_zh: 骑兵10万，另有大量步兵后勤

mobei.note: Huo Qubing's men went as far as Mount Langjuxu and held a victory sacrifice there (封狼居胥).
mobei.note_zh: 霍去病追击至狼居胥山并祭天，即“封狼居胥”。
mobei.losses: Xiongnu c. 90,000 killed or captured (Han claim); Han lost over 100,000 horses
mobei.losses_zh: 据汉方记载匈奴被杀俘约9万人；汉军损失马匹10余万

sides.name: Han
sides.troops_text: c. 100,000, incl. river fleets (Records of the Grand Historian)

nanyue.losses: Panyu burned; Lü Jia and Zhao Jiande captured
nanyue.losses_zh: 番禺城被焚，吕嘉、赵建德被俘

sides.name: Han
sides.troops_text: a fleet from Shandong and a land army from Liaodong; the Records of the Grand Historian give 50,000
sides.troops_text_zh: 山东水军与辽东陆军两路，《史记》称兵五万

gojoseon.note: The two Han generals quarrelled and the siege dragged on; the city fell after Joseon ministers killed their king.
gojoseon.note_zh: 两位汉将不和，围城久攻不下；朝鲜大臣杀死国王后城破。
gojoseon.losses: King Ugeo killed by his own ministers
gojoseon.losses_zh: 朝鲜王右渠被本国大臣所杀

sides.name: Han
sides.troops_text: c. 60,000 on the second expedition (102 BCE)
sides.troops_text_zh: 第二次出征约6万人（前102年）

heavenly-horses.note: The first expedition (104 BCE) failed; on the second, Han cut the city's water supply and Dayuan's nobles killed their king and gave up their horses.
heavenly-horses.note_zh: 第一次远征（前104年）失败；第二次汉军断绝城中水源，大宛贵族杀国王毋寡献马求和。
heavenly-horses.losses: Only about 10,000 Han men returned; Han took over 3,000 horses
heavenly-horses.losses_zh: 汉军仅约1万人生还；获马三千余匹

zhizhi.note: Chen Tang raised the army without the court's permission and later wrote: 'Whoever offends the mighty Han will be punished, however far away.'
zhizhi.note_zh: 陈汤矫诏发兵，事后上疏称“明犯强汉者，虽远必诛”。
zhizhi.losses: Zhizhi Chanyu and 1,518 of his people killed
zhizhi.losses_zh: 郅支单于及阏氏、太子、名王以下1518人被杀

routes.name: Liu Bang's war against Xiang Yu
routes.summary: Liu Bang came out of Hanzhong by Chencang, took Guanzhong, lost Pengcheng in 205, held Xingyang for years, and with his allies trapped Xiang Yu at Gaixia in 202 BCE.
routes.summary_zh: 刘邦“暗度陈仓”出汉中，平定关中，前205年在彭城大败，长期坚守荥阳，前202年联合诸侯在垓下围歼项羽。

routes.name: Zhang Qian's journey to the Western Regions
routes.summary: Sent to find the Yuezhi, Zhang Qian was held by the Xiongnu for about ten years, escaped west to Dayuan, Kangju, the Yuezhi and Bactria, and came home along the southern edge of the Tarim Basin (route partly estimated).
routes.summary_zh: 张骞奉命出使大月氏，被匈奴扣留约十年，逃出后经大宛、康居到达大月氏和大夏，回程沿塔里木盆地南缘返回（路线部分为推测）。

routes.name: Silk Road
routes.summary: After Han took the Hexi Corridor, envoys and caravans travelled from Chang'an through Dunhuang and the Tarim oases to Central Asia and on towards Persia.
routes.summary_zh: 汉朝夺取河西后，使者与商队从长安出发，经敦煌和塔里木盆地诸绿洲通往中亚，并继续西达波斯。

routes.name: Huo Qubing's Hexi campaign
routes.summary: Huo Qubing's cavalry crossed the Yellow River at Longxi and swept west past Mount Yanzhi, breaking Xiongnu power in the Hexi Corridor.
routes.summary_zh: 霍去病率骑兵从陇西渡河，向西越过焉支山，击溃河西走廊的匈奴势力。

routes.name: Huo Qubing's march north of the Gobi
routes.summary: Huo Qubing led his cavalry from Dai across the Gobi and defeated the Xiongnu Wise King of the Left, reaching Mount Langjuxu (location estimated, probably in the Khentii range).
routes.summary_zh: 霍去病率骑兵从代郡出发越过戈壁，大败匈奴左贤王，到达狼居胥山（位置为推测，一般认为在今肯特山一带）。

routes.name: Han conquest of Nanyue
routes.summary: Yang Pu's river fleet came from Yuzhang over the Meiling pass and down the Bei River, while Lu Bode came from Guiyang; they met at Panyu.
routes.summary_zh: 楼船将军杨仆从豫章出发，越过梅岭沿北江南下；伏波将军路博德从桂阳出兵，两军会师番禺。

routes.name: Han conquest of Gojoseon
routes.summary: Yang Pu's fleet sailed from Shandong across the Bohai Sea to Wanggeom (Pyongyang), while Xun Zhi's army marched overland from Liaodong.
routes.summary_zh: 杨仆率水军从山东渡渤海直趋王险城（今平壤），荀彘率陆军从辽东进攻。

routes.name: War of the Heavenly Horses
routes.summary: Li Guangli's armies marched from Dunhuang along the northern edge of the Tarim Basin and over the Pamirs to besiege the capital of Dayuan in the Ferghana Valley.
routes.summary_zh: 李广利率军从敦煌出发，沿塔里木盆地北缘西进，翻越葱岭，围攻费尔干纳盆地中的大宛都城。

people.name: Chunyu Yi
people.known_for: Physician whose 25 recorded case histories are the oldest in China; his daughter Tiying's plea led Emperor Wen to abolish mutilating punishments.
people.known_for_zh: 留下中国最早的25则医案；其女缇萦上书救父，促使汉文帝废除肉刑。

people.name: Jia Yi
people.known_for: Brilliant young scholar-official whose essay on the faults of Qin explained why the Qin fell so fast.
people.known_for_zh: 才华横溢的青年政论家，其《过秦论》分析秦朝速亡的原因。
people.line_zh: 仁义不施而攻守之势异也。
people.line_en: It failed to rule with benevolence, not seeing that holding power differs from winning it.

people.name: Liu An
people.known_for: King of Huainan who gathered scholars to compile the Huainanzi, a summary of Daoist-based learning.
people.known_for_zh: 淮南王，召集门客编成以道家为主的《淮南子》。

people.name: Dong Zhongshu
people.known_for: Persuaded Emperor Wu to make Confucianism the state orthodoxy, linking Heaven and human affairs.
people.known_for_zh: 建议汉武帝“罢黜百家，独尊儒术”，提出天人感应。

works.title: Luxuriant Dew of the Spring and Autumn Annals

people.name: Sima Xiangru
people.known_for: Greatest master of the Han fu (rhapsody); his elopement with Zhuo Wenjun is a famous love story.
people.known_for_zh: 汉赋最杰出的作家，与卓文君私奔的故事广为流传。

people.name: Zhang Qian
people.known_for: Envoy whose journeys to Central Asia (from 138 BCE) opened Han contact with the West and the Silk Road.
people.known_for_zh: 出使西域（自公元前138年起），开辟汉朝与西方的交往和丝绸之路。

people.name: Sima Qian
people.known_for: Wrote the Records of the Grand Historian, China's first general history arranged by biographies.
people.known_for_zh: 著《史记》，中国第一部纪传体通史。
people.line_zh: 人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛。
people.line_en: Everyone must die; some deaths are weightier than Mount Tai, some lighter than a feather.

people.name: Liu Xiang
people.known_for: Imperial librarian who edited and catalogued the court's ancient books.
people.known_for_zh: 皇家图书校勘者，整理编目宫廷所藏古籍。

people.name: Consort Ban
people.known_for: Learned consort of Emperor Cheng, admired as a woman poet and model of virtue; great-aunt of Ban Gu and Ban Zhao.
people.known_for_zh: 汉成帝的才女妃嫔，以诗文和贤德著称，是班固、班昭的姑祖母。

people.name: Xiang Yu
people.known_for: Hegemon-King of Western Chu who toppled Qin and fought Liu Bang in the Chu-Han Contention, ending with his suicide at Wujiang.
people.known_for_zh: 西楚霸王，灭秦后与刘邦争天下，兵败乌江自刎。

people.name: Liu Bang (Emperor Gaozu of Han)
people.known_for: Peasant-born rebel who defeated Xiang Yu and founded the Han dynasty in 202 BCE.
people.known_for_zh: 出身布衣，击败项羽，于前202年建立汉朝。

people.name: Empress Lü Zhi
people.known_for: Liu Bang's empress and later empress dowager, the first woman to wield supreme power in imperial China.
people.known_for_zh: 汉高祖皇后，临朝称制，中国首位掌握最高权力的女性。

people.name: Xiao He
people.known_for: Liu Bang's first chancellor who secured supplies, preserved Qin records and drafted the Han legal code.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初丞相，保障军需、收秦图籍，制定《九章律》。

people.name: Zhang Liang
people.known_for: Strategist whose counsel guided Liu Bang to victory; one of the Three Heroes of early Han.
people.known_for_zh: 运筹帷幄的谋士，辅佐刘邦取天下，汉初三杰之一。

people.name: Han Xin
people.known_for: Brilliant general who won Liu Bang's key campaigns, famed for fighting with backs to the river; later executed.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初名将，背水一战，为刘邦夺取天下，后遭诛杀。

people.name: Cao Shen
people.known_for: Second Han chancellor who kept Xiao He's policies unchanged, a model of Huang-Lao non-interference.
people.known_for_zh: 继萧何为相，萧规曹随，奉行黄老无为之治。

people.name: Chen Ping
people.known_for: Crafty strategist of Liu Bang and later chancellor who helped crush the Lü clan in 180 BCE.
people.known_for_zh: 刘邦谋士，后任丞相，与周勃共诛诸吕。

people.name: Zhou Bo
people.known_for: Han founding general who seized the capital's northern army to overthrow the Lü clan and enthrone Emperor Wen.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初开国将领，夺北军诛诸吕，迎立汉文帝。

people.name: Fan Kuai
people.known_for: Former dog butcher and Liu Bang's brother-in-law who rescued him at the Feast at Hong Gate.
people.known_for_zh: 屠狗出身的猛将，鸿门宴上护卫刘邦脱险。

people.name: Lu Jia
people.known_for: Early Han thinker and envoy who urged Liu Bang to rule by Confucian virtue in his New Discourses.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初思想家、使节，著《新语》劝高祖以仁义治国。

people.name: Zhao Tuo
people.known_for: Qin general who founded the kingdom of Nanyue in the far south and ruled it for some seventy years.
people.known_for_zh: 秦将，建立南越国，统治岭南约七十年。

people.name: Zhang Cang
people.known_for: Han chancellor and mathematician credited with editing the Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art and setting the calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初丞相、数学家，相传曾整理《九章算术》并定历法。

works.title: The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art

people.name: Emperor Wen of Han
people.known_for: Frugal emperor who cut taxes and abolished mutilating punishments, beginning the Rule of Wen and Jing.
people.known_for_zh: 节俭爱民，轻徭薄赋、废除肉刑，开创文景之治。

people.name: Chao Cuo
people.known_for: Statesman who urged reducing the feudal kingdoms, sparking the Rebellion of the Seven States and his own execution.
people.known_for_zh: 主张削藩，引发七国之乱，被腰斩于东市。

people.name: Zhou Yafu
people.known_for: Disciplined general of the Xiliu camp who crushed the Rebellion of the Seven States in three months.
people.known_for_zh: 细柳营治军严明，三个月平定七国之乱。

people.name: Mei Sheng
people.known_for: Early Han fu poet whose Seven Stimuli founded a new fu genre.
people.known_for_zh: 西汉辞赋家，《七发》开创“七体”。

people.name: Emperor Wu of Han
people.known_for: Expansionist emperor who fought the Xiongnu, opened the Western Regions and made Confucianism state orthodoxy.
people.known_for_zh: 北击匈奴、开通西域，独尊儒术，汉朝极盛。

people.name: Empress Wei Zifu
people.known_for: Singer turned empress of Emperor Wu for 38 years, whose family produced the generals Wei Qing and Huo Qubing.
people.known_for_zh: 由歌女立为汉武帝皇后三十八年，卫青、霍去病出其家族。

people.name: Wei Qing
people.known_for: Grand marshal who led seven victorious campaigns against the Xiongnu, retaking the Ordos.
people.known_for_zh: 大将军，七击匈奴，收复河套。

people.name: Huo Qubing
people.known_for: Young cavalry commander who drove the Xiongnu from the Hexi Corridor and reached Mount Langjuxu.
people.known_for_zh: 少年名将，夺取河西走廊，封狼居胥。

people.name: Li Guang
people.known_for: The 'Flying General' feared by the Xiongnu yet never ennobled; famous for an arrow sunk into a rock.
people.known_for_zh: “飞将军”，令匈奴畏服，射石没镞，终身未封侯。

people.name: Gongsun Hong
people.known_for: Confucian scholar who rose from swineherd to chancellor, the first commoner ennobled for scholarship.
people.known_for_zh: 牧猪出身的儒生，官至丞相，以布衣封侯。

people.name: Zhang Tang
people.known_for: Harsh Legalist minister who drafted strict laws and enforced Emperor Wu's salt and coinage policies.
people.known_for_zh: 酷吏代表，修订律令，推行盐铁、五铢钱政策。

people.name: Zhufu Yan
people.known_for: Adviser whose Edict of Grace split princely fiefs among all sons, dissolving the power of the kingdoms.
people.known_for_zh: 献“推恩令”，使诸侯王国分割削弱。

people.name: Sang Hongyang
people.known_for: Finance minister who created state salt and iron monopolies and price-stabilisation schemes.
people.known_for_zh: 理财大臣，推行盐铁官营、均输平准。

people.name: Dongfang Shuo
people.known_for: Witty courtier and writer at Emperor Wu's court, later revered as an immortal of folklore.
people.known_for_zh: 汉武帝时的滑稽文人，诙谐善辩，后被神化。

people.name: Zhuo Wenjun
people.known_for: Widow who eloped with poet Sima Xiangru; credited with the poem 'White Head Lament'.
people.known_for_zh: 与司马相如私奔的才女，相传作《白头吟》。

people.name: Luoxia Hong
people.known_for: Astronomer who helped create the Taichu calendar of 104 BCE and built an armillary sphere.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，参与制定太初历，制造浑仪。

people.name: Emperor Xuan of Han
people.known_for: Emperor raised in prison who revived Han governance and set up the Protectorate of the Western Regions.
people.known_for_zh: 在狱中长大的皇帝，励精图治，设西域都护，史称中兴。

people.name: Su Wu
people.known_for: Envoy held by the Xiongnu for 19 years, herding sheep by Lake Baikal yet never renouncing Han.
people.known_for_zh: 出使匈奴被扣十九年，北海牧羊，持节不屈。

people.name: Li Ling
people.known_for: Grandson of Li Guang who surrendered to the Xiongnu after a doomed campaign; defending him cost Sima Qian dearly.
people.known_for_zh: 李广之孙，兵败降匈奴，司马迁因为其辩护受宫刑。

people.name: Princess Jieyou
people.known_for: Han princess married to Wusun kings who forged a Han-Wusun alliance against the Xiongnu.
people.known_for_zh: 和亲乌孙的汉朝公主，促成汉乌联盟共击匈奴。

people.name: Huo Guang
people.known_for: Regent for two decades who deposed one emperor and installed Emperor Xuan.
people.known_for_zh: 辅政二十年，废昌邑王，立汉宣帝。

people.name: Zhao Chongguo
people.known_for: General who pacified the Qiang by establishing military farming colonies along the Huang River.
people.known_for_zh: 老将平定西羌，首创湟水屯田。

people.name: Chen Tang
people.place_zh: 西域都护府（乌垒，今新疆轮台）
people.known_for: Officer who killed Xiongnu chanyu Zhizhi in 36 BCE, declaring 'whoever offends mighty Han will be punished'.
people.known_for_zh: 斩杀郅支单于，留下“犯强汉者，虽远必诛”。

people.name: Jing Fang
people.known_for: Yijing scholar and music theorist who devised a 60-tone tuning system and divination by hexagrams.
people.known_for_zh: 易学家、音律学家，创六十律与纳甲卦气说。

works.title: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes

people.name: Wang Zhaojun
people.known_for: Palace lady married to the Xiongnu chanyu in 33 BCE, bringing decades of peace; one of the Four Beauties.
people.known_for_zh: 出塞和亲匈奴，带来边境和平，四大美人之一。

people.name: Fan Shengzhi
people.known_for: Agronomist whose manual described pit farming and seed treatment, China's oldest surviving agricultural treatise.
people.known_for_zh: 农学家，著《氾胜之书》，记述区田法等耕作技术。

people.name: Kong Anguo
people.known_for: Descendant of Confucius who deciphered the Old Text Book of Documents found in the wall of Confucius's house.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子后裔，整理孔壁所出古文《尚书》，古文经学先驱。

people.name: Yang Xiong
people.known_for: Poet and philosopher famed for rhapsodies, a dialect dictionary and works modelled on the Analects and Book of Changes.
people.known_for_zh: 辞赋家、哲学家，著有方言词典，并仿《论语》《周易》著书。

people.name: Liu Xin
people.known_for: Scholar and astronomer who catalogued the imperial library, championed Old Text classics and served Wang Mang.
people.known_for_zh: 学者、天文学家，编成图书目录《七略》，推崇古文经，为王莽重臣。

people.name: Wang Mang
people.known_for: Usurper who founded the Xin dynasty and launched sweeping land and currency reforms that ended in revolt.
people.known_for_zh: 篡汉建立新朝，推行土地币制改制，引发天下大乱。

people.name: Lü Mu
people.known_for: Woman who led an uprising against Xin to avenge her son, one of China's first female rebel leaders.
people.known_for_zh: 为子复仇起兵反新，中国最早的女性起义领袖之一。

people.name: Fan Chong
people.known_for: Leader of the Red Eyebrows peasant army, who painted their brows red and sacked Chang'an.
people.known_for_zh: 赤眉军首领，以赤眉为号，攻入长安。

people.name: Liu Yan (Bosheng)
people.known_for: Elder brother of Liu Xiu who raised the Han restoration army in Nanyang against Wang Mang.
people.known_for_zh: 刘秀之兄，在南阳起兵反莽，倡导复汉。

people.name: Gengshi Emperor (Liu Xuan)
people.known_for: Lülin-backed Han claimant whose forces destroyed Wang Mang in 23 CE.
people.known_for_zh: 绿林军拥立的汉帝，其军于23年攻灭王莽。

people.name: Yan You
people.known_for: Xin general and strategist who warned Wang Mang against war with the Xiongnu and fought at Kunyang.
people.known_for_zh: 新朝将领、兵法家，谏阻伐匈奴，参与昆阳之战。

people.name: Huan Tan
people.known_for: Skeptical thinker and musician who rejected prophetic apocrypha, author of New Treatise.
people.known_for_zh: 思想家、音乐家，反对谶纬，著《新论》。

people.name: Gongsun Shu
people.known_for: Warlord who declared himself emperor of Chengjia in Sichuan until conquered by Eastern Han.
people.known_for_zh: 割据蜀地称帝，国号成家，后为东汉所灭。

people.name: Wei Xiao
people.known_for: Warlord of Longxi who wavered between Liu Xiu and Gongsun Shu, inspiring the phrase 'having won Long, eye Shu'.
people.known_for_zh: 割据陇右的军阀，留下“得陇望蜀”典故。

people.name: Yan Guang
people.known_for: Recluse friend of Liu Xiu who refused office to fish on the Fuchun River, a model of integrity.
people.known_for_zh: 光武帝故友，拒绝出仕，隐居富春江垂钓。

check.n: Wikipedia gives c. 1-75; Chinese sources give 39 BC-AD 41. Sources disagree.
check.n_zh: 英文维基作约1—75年，中文资料作前39—41年，说法分歧。

people.name: Du Shi
people.known_for: Prefect of Nanyang who invented the water-powered bellows for casting iron.
people.known_for_zh: 南阳太守，发明水排鼓风冶铁。

capitals.name: Yueyang
capitals.note: Liu Bang's capital until Chang'an was ready.
capitals.note_zh: 长安建成前刘邦的都城。

capitals.name: Chang'an
capitals.note: Named capital in 202 BCE; the court moved in 200 BCE.
capitals.note_zh: 公元前202年定都，前200年迁入。

capitals.name: Longcheng
capitals.note: Shanyu's ritual centre on the Mongolian steppe; exact site uncertain, location approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 单于在漠北的祭祀中心，确切位置未定，坐标为约数。
